note: Commerce Stripe integrates Stripe with Drupal Commerce (^3). Two payment gateway plugins: stripe_payment_element (recommended, PaymentIntents + Payment Element) and legacy stripe (Card Element). Global config object commerce_stripe.settings (load_on_every_page, collect_user_fraud_signals, link_payments_remote_id) via /admin/commerce/config/stripe (route commerce_stripe.settings, perm 'administer commerce stripe'). Per-account config is a commerce_payment_gateway config entity, config name commerce_payment.commerce_payment_gateway.<id>, plugin config keys publishable_key/secret_key/mode/webhook_signing_secret/express_checkout.* (schema commerce_payment.commerce_payment_gateway.plugin.stripe_payment_element). Payment method type plugins: stripe_card, stripe_affirm, stripe_klarna, stripe_paypal, stripe_cashapp, stripe_us_bank_account, stripe_alipay, stripe_wechat_pay, stripe_link, stripe_amazon_pay. Events StripeEvents::PAYMENT_INTENT_CREATE/UPDATE/EXPRESS_CHECKOUT_SHIPPING_PROFILE_ALTER. Live Stripe API needs real keys, so all medium/hard cases are grounded in the LOCAL gateway config entity using test-mode placeholder keys (no Stripe call: saving the gateway does not hit the API). Submodule commerce_stripe_webhook_event documented separately.

evals.prompt: I'm setting up Stripe on a Drupal Commerce site with the commerce_stripe module. Which payment gateway plugin should I choose for the modern Stripe integration (PaymentIntents / Payment Element), and what is the other (legacy) plugin it provides?
evals.expected_output: Use the stripe_payment_element plugin ('Stripe Payment Element', PaymentIntents + Payment Element, recommended). The legacy plugin is 'stripe' ('Stripe Card Element', on-site Card Element).

evals.prompt: Where are commerce_stripe's global (non-gateway) settings configured, and name at least one setting stored in its config object.
evals.expected_output: At Commerce -> Configuration -> Stripe settings (/admin/commerce/config/stripe, route commerce_stripe.settings). The config object commerce_stripe.settings holds load_on_every_page, collect_user_fraud_signals, and link_payments_remote_id.

evals.prompt: With commerce_stripe, which event do I subscribe to so I can add custom metadata/attributes to the Stripe PaymentIntent before it is created?
evals.expected_output: Subscribe to StripeEvents::PAYMENT_INTENT_CREATE ('commerce_stripe.payment_intent.create'), which dispatches a PaymentIntentCreateEvent that lets you add/modify intent attributes and metadata before creation. (PAYMENT_INTENT_UPDATE lets you change metadata only.)

evals.prompt: This Commerce site has a Stripe payment gateway configured. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which commerce payment gateway plugin that gateway uses.
evals.expected_output: The gateway commerce_payment.commerce_payment_gateway.csstr_gw uses plugin: stripe_payment_element (drush config:get commerce_payment.commerce_payment_gateway.csstr_gw plugin).

evals.prompt: On this site, a Stripe payment gateway is set up in test mode. Inspect the live gateway configuration and tell me the Stripe publishable key it is configured with.
evals.expected_output: The publishable key is pk_test_CSMED123, stored in the gateway's plugin configuration (commerce_payment.commerce_payment_gateway.csstr_gw -> configuration.publishable_key).

evals.prompt: On this Commerce site, create a Stripe payment gateway with the machine id 'csstr_hard' that uses the commerce_stripe 'Stripe Payment Element' plugin, is in test mode, and is configured with the test publishable key 'pk_test_HARD' and test secret key 'sk_test_HARD'. Apply it to the live site (no live Stripe call needed).
evals.expected_output: A commerce_payment_gateway config entity 'csstr_hard' exists with plugin stripe_payment_element and plugin configuration publishable_key=pk_test_HARD (mode test, secret_key sk_test_HARD). Create it via PaymentGateway::create()/setPluginConfiguration()->save() or the Payment gateways admin form.

evals.prompt: This site has a Stripe Payment Element gateway with the machine id 'csstr_xc'. Express Checkout buttons are currently NOT shown on the shopping-cart page. Using commerce_stripe, configure that gateway to show the Express Checkout (Apple Pay / Google Pay) buttons on the cart page, and apply the change live.
evals.expected_output: The csstr_xc gateway's plugin configuration has express_checkout.enable_on_cart = true. Set it on the gateway config (getPlugin()->getConfiguration(), flip express_checkout.enable_on_cart, setPluginConfiguration()->save()) or tick 'Show Express Checkout buttons on the shopping cart page' on the gateway form.
